**v1.11.0: the battle simulator casts your boosts in the bot's order - so the Sharpen goes on the blade the bot sharpens.**
- **What was wrong.** The simulator (the boss deck pick, the planner, the zone deck) cast the blade, trap or aura with the biggest % first. The bot casts them in a fixed order, one a round: Feint, then the traps (your school's, Elemental / Spirit, Hex), then the blades (your school's, Elemental / Spirit, Balanceblade, Bladestorm), the aura last; on a hit of two or more schools (a Hydra), of the blades the one that adds the most to the whole hit first - Elemental Blade (all three heads) before Balanceblade, before Stormblade (one head) - and the same for the traps. So the simulator could sharpen Elemental Blade where the bot sharpens Stormblade (or the other way round on a Hydra), cast a 30% trap after a 35% blade, or put an aura up before Bladestorm.
- **What changes.** The simulator now casts them in the bot's order, a party's Blader or Healer too (their blades and traps for the hitter's hit). The Sharpen goes on the first blade the bot casts while its sharpened cast is free - your school's before Elemental Blade, a Hydra's on Elemental Blade - and the Potent on the first trap: Feint, then your school's, a Hydra's on Elemental Trap, else Hex. Nothing changes in the game: the bot plays its cards as it always has, there is no new setting, and the AutoFarmer sends the helper nothing new.
- **Measured on the same dice** (2000 battles a cell, each battle on the same seed in v1.10.1 and v1.11.0): a Storm wizard (a Balance one for the Hydra deck) with 3000 health and 60% damage against a 6000-health boss or 3 mobs of 1500 health (2-pip hits of 150-200 and 100-150 that always land), "Boost first, then hit" and `boostmax` 0 (the defaults). % won v1.10.1 -> v1.11.0 with `discardspent` on (this AutoFarmer's default), then with `reboost` on (and where it says so with "Hit first (fast)", `discardspent` on); in brackets, the battles only v1.11.0 won / only v1.10.1 won:
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Bladestorm + 3 Storm Aura + 3 Stormblade against 3 mobs: 62.5% -> 68.7% (+320 / -197); 77.3% -> 78.0% (+147 / -134); with "Hit first (fast)" 62.9% -> 66.7% (+241 / -165). Against the boss: 94.6% -> 95.3% (+60 / -46); 97.3% -> 97.8% (+26 / -18). The aura (up for 4 rounds) now goes after Bladestorm, as the bot casts it, so more of it is left when the 7-pip Storm Lord goes: it was up for 44.5% of the Storm Lords cast against the mobs, 39.2% before.
  - Balance: 8 Hydra + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 2 Balanceblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against the boss: 87.6% -> 88.7% (+74 / -52); 95.0% -> 95.0% (+30 / -29). Against 3 mobs: 40.4% -> 40.2% (+93 / -96); 49.8% -> 50.0% (+136 / -132). With "Hit first (fast)": the boss 85.2% -> 86.3% (+65 / -42), 3 mobs 41.4% -> 45.5% (+185 / -102). The first Sharpen now goes on Elemental Blade (+10% on all three heads), and Stormblade goes last.
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap (the 30% trap now before the 35% blade): the boss 96.9% -> 97.0% (+5 / -2); 97.1% -> 96.8% (+0 / -5). 3 mobs: 44.4% -> 44.1% (+19 / -23); 75.3% -> 75.3% (+18 / -17).
  - 4 Storm Lord + 4 Tempest + 3 Stormblade + 3 Storm Trap + 2 Feint + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 96.7% -> 96.7% (+7 / -7); 97.2% -> 97.2% (+7 / -8). 3 mobs: 90.9% -> 91.0% (+29 / -26); 90.2% -> 90.7% (+50 / -41).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade (the first Sharpen now on Stormblade, your school's - before, on whichever came first in hand): the boss 97.6% -> 97.8% (+8 / -4); 98.8% -> 99.1% (+6 / -1). 3 mobs: 47.0% -> 47.1% (+32 / -29); 75.0% -> 74.5% (+22 / -30).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 4 Stormblade + 4 Elemental Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 97.2% -> 97.2% (+5 / -4); 98.5% -> 98.5% (+0 / -2). 3 mobs: 47.8% -> 47.7% (+27 / -29); 77.5% -> 77.2% (+23 / -30).
  - The same battles, battle for battle, with `discardspent` on, with `reboost` on and with "Hit first (fast)": 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade (the boss 92.2%, 3 mobs 34.2% with `discardspent` on); 8 Storm Lord + 1 Stormblade + 1 Sharpened Blade; 10 Thunder Snake + 6 Storm Lord + 4 Sharpened Blade (no blade); and 8 Storm Lord + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap at 40% + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap - PlayerStats.txt's default %s, your school's trap (40) above its blade (35), where the biggest % first was the bot's order already.
- **The simulator plays everything else exactly as before**, against v1.10.1: 141 random decks with no blade, trap or aura (25) or with one boost slot (116 - one kind of blade, trap or aura: two storm blades at different %s are one slot, Balanceblade and Bladestorm two; 96 of them with two or more copies of a card, 27 with a treasure card's copy, 26 with a second card of the slot at another %), 63 of the 141 with Sharpen or Potent: 4230 simulate (3 seeds and 10 sets of settings a deck), 705 planner (as Hitter, Blader and Healer), 141 team plan and 99 deck pick comparisons, 0 differing. Of 129 random decks with two or more boost slots, 88 play differently somewhere (1306 of 3870 simulate, 247 of 645 planner, 47 of 129 team plan and 110 of 171 deck pick comparisons), as they should.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper: its simulator plays the bot's order too - every AutoFarmer casts its boosts in this order. This AutoFarmer with an older helper: that helper's biggest % first, as before. The zone deck is worked out once more after updating.
- **Nothing to try in the game.** The bot plays as before, so there is no LIVE_CHECKS step. To compare with the bot, debug.log's "plan: ..." line (written for a hit of two or more schools, for example) ends "this round: ..." with the blades and traps the bot can put up, in the order it casts them.
- **Still not in it:** boosts with no hit in hand (the bot boosts for your school's hit even then); `boostmax`'s escape - the bot boosts past it while no hit can go, the simulator doesn't, so with `boostmax` set it boosts less than the bot; the prism, Attenuate and your school's bubble in the bot's boost chain (the simulator plays none of them); your own PlayerStats.txt %s for Balanceblade, Bladestorm, Hex and Feint (`blade3`, `blade4`, `trap3`, `feint`: the simulator tells those cards apart by the nearest of the defaults, 25, 20, 30 and 70); the enemies' cheats.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
